unreadTooltip: {count, plural, =0 {Google Chat Client} one {Google Chat Client · 1 unread message} other {Google Chat Client · # unread messages}}
errNetwork: couldn't reach Google Chat; check your connection and try again
errBadResponse: Google Chat's response couldn't be read
errServiceDisabled: the Google Chat API isn't enabled in this account's project; enable it in APIs & Services > Library, in Google Cloud
errScopeMissing: this session is missing a Chat permission; check the scopes under Data access and connect the account again
errChatAppMissing: the Chat app isn't configured in the project; fill in the name, icon and description on the Configuration tab of the Google Chat API
errUnauthorized: the session was rejected; connect this account again
errRateLimited: Google is rate limiting requests; wait a bit before refreshing
errNotFound: this conversation or message is no longer available to the selected account
errThreadMismatch: the thread doesn't belong to the selected conversation
errAttachmentNotUploaded: the attachment didn't finish uploading; try sending again
errMessageSize: write a message of up to 32,000 bytes
errCredentialsFile: choose the JSON of a Desktop app OAuth client, downloaded from Google Cloud
errLoginRunning: a sign-in is already in progress
errCopyText: text is empty or too long to copy
errInvalidLink: this link isn't a valid web address
errConfigCorrupt: the local configuration couldn't be read
errConfigAccount: the configuration contains an invalid account
errInterval: choose one of the offered intervals
errClientType: import the credentials of a Desktop app OAuth client
errNoSecret: the credentials file has no client_secret
errSaveCredentials: store credentials in the system keyring
errProjectInUse: remove this project's accounts before removing the project
errCredentialsMissing: import the project's OAuth credentials in settings; check that the system keyring is unlocked
errCredentialsInvalid: the OAuth credentials are invalid; import the file again
errSessionLoad: couldn't restore the session; unlock the keyring or connect this account again
errSessionExpired: this account's session expired or was revoked; connect the account again
errSessionRefresh: couldn't renew the session; check your connection and, if it persists, connect this account again
errNotAFile: choose a regular file, not a folder
errUploadUnconfirmed: Google didn't confirm the file upload
errDownloadInterrupted: the download was interrupted; try again
errDownloadTooLarge: the attachment is larger than Google Chat's limit
errLoginBusy: a sign-in is already in progress; finish or cancel it before starting another
errChooseProject: choose an imported project to connect the account
callbackInvalid: Invalid sign-in response. Go back to the app and try again.
callbackFailed: Sign-in wasn't completed. Go back to Google Chat Client to see why.
callbackDone: You can go back to Google Chat Client. The app is finishing connecting the account.
errLoginCanceled: sign-in was canceled or timed out; try connecting the account again
errExchange: Google didn't complete the sign-in; check that the OAuth client is a Desktop app
errScopeDenied: a Chat permission wasn't granted; connect again and accept the requested permissions
errUserinfo: couldn't look up the Google account's identity
errIdentity: Google didn't return a valid account identity
errNoRefresh: Google didn't provide a persistent session; try connecting again and accept the consent
errSaveSession: store the session in the system keyring
errAccessDenied: access wasn't authorized; connect again and accept the requested permissions
errAdminPolicy: this account's Workspace administrator blocked the app; ask them to mark the client ID as trusted in Security > Access and data control > API controls
errOrgInternal: the OAuth project only accepts accounts from its own organization; change the audience to External in Google Cloud
errConsent: Google didn't authorize access; check the consent and the Workspace policies
notifyOpenToRead: Open the conversation to read the message
errFileTooLarge: {name} is larger than 200 MB, Google Chat's limit
